def solve(case):
    nodes = case['nodes']
    required_symbols = set(case['required_symbols'])
    node_map = {node['id']: node for node in nodes}
    children_map = {}
    for node in nodes:
        parent = node['parent']
        if parent is not None:
            children_map.setdefault(parent, []).append(node['id'])
    # identify root(s) - assume one root with parent None
    root_ids = [node['id'] for node in nodes if node['parent'] is None]
    root_id = root_ids[0] if root_ids else None
    # initial retained set and symbol counts
    retained = set(node['id'] for node in nodes)
    symbol_counts = {}
    for node in nodes:
        s = node['symbol']
        symbol_counts[s] = symbol_counts.get(s, 0) + 1
    # order nodes by depth desc, then id asc
    sorted_nodes = sorted(nodes, key=lambda n: (-n['depth'], n['id']))
    removed = []
    for node in sorted_nodes:
        node_id = node['id']
        if node_id not in retained:
            continue
        if not node['removable']:
            continue
        if node_id == root_id:
            continue
        # check if any child still retained
        children = children_map.get(node_id, [])
        if any(child in retained for child in children):
            continue
        # check required symbols
        sym = node['symbol']
        if sym in required_symbols and symbol_counts.get(sym, 0) <= 1:
            continue
        # remove
        removed.append(node_id)
        retained.remove(node_id)
        symbol_counts[sym] = symbol_counts.get(sym, 0) - 1
    retained_sorted = sorted(retained)
    return {'removed_node_ids': removed, 'retained_node_ids': retained_sorted}
